# Robert Jurgens, FCAS

> Chicago-based Property & Casualty Actuary (FCAS) specializing in Cayman-domiciled captive insurance, pricing architecture, increased limit factors (ILFs), economic capital modeling, and native Rust / Excel XLL software.

- Current Role: Senior Actuarial Consultant, Edgewater Actuarial Insights, LLC (Jul 2023 – Present; promoted Aug 2025)
- Credentials: Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS, 2022); Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS, 2021)
- Education: B.S. in Mathematics (Highest Honors), The University of Texas at Austin (2018); Eugene Wisdom Memorial Endowed Scholarship in Actuarial Studies
- Technical Core: Rust, Python, C#, R, Excel XLLs, VBA / Power Query, MetaRisk, WebAssembly, Statistical & Bayesian Modeling

## Core Experience

- **Edgewater Actuarial Insights, LLC (2023–Present)**: Leads actuarial oversight across Cayman-domiciled group and single-parent captives; directs actuarial staff across reserving, renewal pricing, new-business pricing, and NCCI Excess Loss Factor benchmarking; led renewal pricing model architecture (Excel, VBA, Power Query, compiled `.xll` add-ins) and engineered a Rust Monte Carlo ILF simulation engine for Auto and General Liability.
- **Oliver Wyman Actuarial Consulting (2022–2023)**: Manager estimating unpaid loss and ALAE reserves for captive and self-insured clients; led client delivery and executive presentations; Central Zone Values Ambassador.
- **Tokio Marine HCC (2018–2022)**: Assistant Actuarial Analyst to Actuarial Supervisor; analyzed S&P Risk-Based Capital Adequacy Model changes, maintained quarterly internal economic capital model, evaluated S&P and Fitch capital impacts, supported casualty XOL reinsurance pricing in MetaRisk and R, built an R-backed Maximum Foreseeable Loss web application, and reserved Aviation and Trade Credit lines.

## Open-Source & Interactive Exhibits

- [Excess Layer & ILF Exhibit](https://sinisterrob.github.io/#lab): Illustrative zero-dependency Rust/WebAssembly model (~9.5 KB) comparing synthetic lognormal severity tails (σ = 0.55, 1.00, 1.55; fixed $100k ground-up mean) across closed-form limited expected values, interactive direct-scrubbing ILF/PDF charts, scenario presets, and a fixed-seed 65,536-draw SplitMix64 Box–Muller Monte Carlo verification check.
- Exhibit Source: https://github.com/SinisterRob/SinisterRob.github.io/blob/main/src/excess_layers.rs
- [reserving-kernels](https://github.com/SinisterRob/reserving-kernels): Pure-Rust actuarial loss-reserving, Mack standard error, ODP bootstrap, portfolio dependence, and parametric severity/ILF crate grounded in primary CAS/ASTIN literature.
